create_bedrock_realtime_handler: create a BedrockRealtime handler instance to establish bidirectional streaming with AWS Bedrock Nova Sonic
run_async_realtime_connection: run async_realtime to connect a WebSocket client to Bedrock Nova Sonic with bidirectional streaming and AWS authentication
forward_client_to_bedrock_messages: forward client WebSocket messages to Bedrock stream by transforming OpenAI format to Bedrock format
forward_bedrock_to_client_responses: forward Bedrock stream responses to client WebSocket by transforming Bedrock format to OpenAI format
test_bedrock_realtime_streaming: test the BedrockRealtime class bidirectional streaming connection with a WebSocket and logging object
